text:
oncall-bot: PAGER: P1 - increased 5xx rate and token latency in us-east inference cluster. Alert fired at 2026-03-17T10:02:12Z. Metrics: 5xx-rate 6.2% (thr 1%), p50 latency 820ms (baseline 120ms). Paging dev-oncall team.

maria: Acked. War room link up: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=abc123 (ops-zoom). Who can take owner? :raising_hand:

devon: I’ll own mitigation. Investigating routing, autoscaler, and KV cache behavior. First action: isolate offending node and enable fallback route to model-chat-v2-small if compatible.

lee: I’ll own external/internal comms. Drafting status page and customer note. Quick ask — which endpoints are impacted?

maria: Initial scope looks like /v1/generate and /v1/chat in us-east. Embeddings seem unaffected so far. Priority = stop 5xx spike.

sara: oncall acked :thumbsup:

ops-runner: Logs sample showing symptoms:
```
WARN inference: KVCache miss spike seq_len=1024 host=gpu-node-17
ERR http: downstream read timeout 502 from gpu-node-17
```

devon: Correlating events: gpu-node-17 underwent a rolling restart ~09:58Z and didn't rejoin properly -> high KV cache miss, backpressure, and downstream 502s. I'm taking node OOS and shifting traffic to healthy pool. Adjusting autoscaler policy to prevent concurrent restarts.

lee: Status page draft:
"We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for inference in US‑East affecting text generation/chat endpoints. Impact: intermittent 5xx errors. Mitigation in progress. Next update: in 30 minutes."

maria: Internal customer comm draft (for ops/customer success):
"We are currently experiencing elevated error rates affecting text generation in US‑East. Our engineers are mitigating impact by removing a degraded GPU node and shifting traffic. We will provide updates every 30 minutes. No customer action required at this time."

devon: Traffic shifted. 5xx rate reduced to ~1.1% from 6.2%. Monitoring for stability. Leaving fallback route ready to enable if errors rise.

sara: Planning handoff: handoff to Jordan in 30 minutes unless resolved. @jordan can you standby?

jordan: Standby acknowledged. I’ll take oncall handoff if needed.

maria: Good. Keep updates short. If 5xx > 3% sustained for 10m escalate to exec-pager channel.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: status changed to "investigating". War room: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=abc123. Incident ID: INC-20260317-001
